obligations.expected_behavior: The Consumer Manifest is ensured to be non-empty before complete route-transition and rollback coverage is applied.
forbidden_result: Complete route-transition or rollback coverage is applied to an empty Consumer Manifest.
The Consumer Manifest's non-empty condition is not established before coverage is applied.
obligations.observable_result: Before coverage is applied, the Consumer Manifest contains at least one entry or the coverage attempt is rejected.
obligations.state_after: A non-empty Consumer Manifest has been established before complete route-transition and rollback coverage is applied.
obligations.state_before: Complete route-transition and rollback coverage is pending, and the Consumer Manifest's non-empty condition has not yet been established.
obligations.subject: Non-empty Consumer Manifest
obligations.trigger: Before applying complete route-transition and rollback coverage.
